summary: The non_gaia variant is a design-and-code Python FastAPI system with service classes and CrewAI agent wrappers. It implements a credible nearby-search service with a 2 km radius and cost sorting, and it includes reservation/cancellation logic, but the reservation service is wired with the wrong dependency in the API startup path. Because that breaks the reservation workflow and because agent cooperation is mostly nominal, this variant needs revision before it can satisfy the requirements reliably.

findings.description: Nearby parking search uses a Haversine distance filter with a default 2 km radius and sorts results by hourly price.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/services/search_service.py:29 defines radius_km=2.0; lines 83-90 filter by distance <= radius_km; lines 92-95 sort by price_per_hour and return the list.

findings.description: The search result is not limited to the required 3 nearest parking lots and is sorted by price only, not by nearest distance first.
findings.evidence: Requirement: return 3 nearest parking lots with free spots, sorted by increasing parking cost. non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/services/search_service.py:92-95 sorts every nearby lot by price_per_hour and returns nearby_lots without a top-3 slice.

findings.description: Reservation creation correctly rejects unavailable lots and past start times in the service implementation.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/services/reservation_service.py:16-22 returns None if the lot is absent, has no spots, or start_time <= datetime.utcnow().

findings.description: The API wires ReservationService with AvailabilityAgent instead of ParkingLotService, so reservation creation will call missing methods at runtime.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/main.py:37-38 constructs ReservationService(next(get_db()), availability_agent), while reservation_service.py:16 and 59 call get_parking_lot and update_availability on that dependency; AvailabilityAgent only exposes check_availability and get_available_parking_lots in agents/availability_agent.py:27-37.

findings.description: API handlers convert intended 400/404 HTTP errors into 500 responses because raised HTTPException objects are caught by the broad exception handler.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/main.py:77-90 raises HTTPException(status_code=400) and then catches Exception as e, raising HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e)).

findings.description: Cancellation updates reservation state and restores parking availability.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/services/reservation_service.py:73-88 sets status='cancelled', increments available_spots, and updates availability.

findings.description: The agent layer does not define message protocols or inter-agent communication; agents mainly wrap service method calls.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/agents/reservation_agent.py:28-60 delegates directly to reservation_service methods, and no message broker or message contract appears in the non_gaia inventory.

findings.description: Search uses hardcoded mock lots while reservation and availability services use the SQL database, so a parking lot returned by search is not guaranteed to be reservable.
findings.evidence: non_gaia/implementation_workspace/parking_system/services/search_service.py:35-78 creates mock_parking_lots; main.py:47-59 uses ParkingLotService(next(get_db())) for database-backed lot endpoints.

missing_requirements: A real agent cooperation protocol is not implemented; the CrewAI agents are wrappers around services.
The required top-3 nearest result behavior is not implemented.
logical_inconsistencies: ReservationService is constructed with AvailabilityAgent even though it requires ParkingLotService-like methods.
The search workflow and reservation workflow operate on different data sources.
The API attempts to raise 400/404 errors but broad exception handling transforms them into 500 errors.
implementation_risks: POST /reservations can fail at runtime with an AttributeError because AvailabilityAgent lacks get_parking_lot and update_availability.
Users may select a parking lot from search results that does not exist in the reservation database.
Clients receive misleading 500 errors for validation and not-found cases.
